svg.title: Architecture of four homelab machines: dusty (Mnemosyne), headless (Hermes), scrapy (Athena), and shadow (Argus)
svg.desc: dusty runs Jellyfin, a Docker web UI, and SFTP upload. headless runs the Docker transmission-API and Transmission daemon, plus native CouchDB, Forgejo, and n8n. scrapy runs native Ollama and Open WebUI. shadow, a physical clone of scrapy's hardware, is a new monitoring host running native Prometheus and Grafana plus a Docker webhook receiver and a Docker restic REST server. All three original hosts send health checks and metrics to shadow over a shared channel, and dusty additionally pushes offsite backups to shadow. dusty's web UI also calls headless's API over REST, headless pushes finished downloads back to dusty over SFTP, and n8n on headless calls Ollama on scrapy. Everything stays inside a Tailscale mesh network.
svg.text: encrypted private network connecting all hosts
